name.description: What people call it: one line of 1 to 100 characters, with no space at either end.

description.description: What somebody gets from it, and who, in 1 to 2,000 characters. What is known to be missing is said here too.

only.description: The condition under which the thing is there at all, begun with "when", "on" or "for", so that it reads after the word "only": `only: when a customer pays by card`. One line of at most 100 characters. Left out when it is always there.

owner.description: The id of the owner, a record in owners/, who is responsible for the feature. It is written on the feature and never taken from its parts.

touches.description: The ids of the parts and connections that are the feature's own and that no flow of it reaches: a person, a system, an app, a store, a component, a piece of infrastructure or a connection. A list with no id twice.

description: A thing the software does for somebody, under the name its own people already use for it, as it is today.
